name: dual_use
description: Requests for information or assistance that has both legitimate and harmful applications. The harm depends on intent and context — the same knowledge can enable protection or enable attack.

name: agentic_misuse
description: Attempts to exploit AI agent capabilities — tool access, memory, multi-step planning, or autonomous action — to cause harm at scale or bypass human oversight. Elevated severity because agents can act without per-step review.

name: privacy_violation
description: Requests that seek to extract, infer, or aggregate personally identifiable information, surveillance capabilities, or data that individuals have a reasonable expectation of controlling.

name: manipulation
description: Requests designed to produce content that psychologically manipulates, deceives, or coerces individuals or groups — including disinformation, targeted persuasion, and social engineering scripts.

name: unsafe_content
description: Requests for content that is directly harmful regardless of use-case framing — including self-harm facilitation, content involving minors, or graphic violence with no legitimate informational purpose.
